image_description: A cartoon-style illustration of a savanna landscape featuring a black koala running behind a male lion. There are seven green-rimmed analog clocks distributed throughout the scene: two on a wooden signpost to the left, three in/on a large tree in the center, one on a distant post to the right, and one resting on a rock in the foreground right. A wooden sign reads 'SAVANNA TIME'.
